content: 💡 一直以來，我們十分重視與讀者和受眾的交流，也深信即使資訊環境變幻無定，只要找到方法看見彼此，始終有誰共鳴。《拾論》承先啟後，更進一步，撿拾讀者留言，同時讓相關編輯或記者主動回應留言，將端的最新動態及報導方向等一一為你補漏拾遺。 香港的狗隻風波從8月一直影響到10月。8月20日，打鼓嶺一間寵物酒店的負責人遭狗咬死，隨後漁護署大舉搜查格鬥犬，而品種大多由獸醫目測判定。於是有狗主的狗被帶走，必須先絕育才能領回，其中一隻惡霸犬更在絕育手術後死亡。到了9月，元朗又有一名27歲女子騎單車時遭流浪狗咬死。 進入10月，台灣先有一場風波。10月4日，蔡康永出現在民進黨台北市長候選人沈伯洋的競選總部成立大會，而就在前一天，台北一間同志酒吧剛遭警方搜查。儘管他至今沒有說明到場原因，中國大陸網民已經群起抵制，零跑汽車也隨即下架與他合作的所有內容。與此同時，台灣也有人翻出他的舊事，替他解釋動機。 幾天後，輪到華為陷入爭議。10月8日，懂車帝發布測試影片，指華為與江淮合作的尊界V800剎車踏板被踩斷，江淮股價因此連續兩天跌停，然而影片隔天就從各平台消失。10月11日，《人民日報》客戶端發文批評「速成車」，可是五天後，人民網總編輯便宣布離職。直到10月15日，工信部等三部門才成立聯合調查組。 此外，長沙的「黑白顛」性商訓練營近期也引起討論。這門三天的課程收費3000元，學員多是35到45歲、婚姻出了狀況的女性。課上導師教她們「不要跟男人硬剛」，而同一層樓還開著私處整形機構。 灣仔，寵物友善商場超市裡的狗。攝：鄧家烜/端傳媒 1. Cloudy ，回應《 香港狗咬人事故：從人寵共融到全城獵狗，狗隻管理鏈是如何斷裂的？ 》 我絕對支持人寵共融，但我同樣支持為貓狗絕育，降低人與動物衝突，同時亦減少無序繁殖帶來的棄養。在歐美地區，經由rescue領養的貓狗均有絕育要求。香港亦應在貓狗救助機構推廣「先絕育再領養」，如貓狗未夠絕育年齡，則在領養合約上加入限時絕育要求，並收取絕育定金。 2. kes ，回應《 專訪《反對普丁的無名先生》導演博倫斯坦：荒謬的宣傳，與被洗腦的人 》 非常出色的訪問，記者做了很多事前準備。謝謝。 「人們會說中國很糟，可是所有國家都很糟，所有國家領導人都腐敗，諸如此類。」 我的香港朋友也說過同樣的話。我明白，只要抱著這種思想，那就可以什麼也不做地過生活。 作出改變，甚至反抗，走上未知的道路，你可以嗎？ 3. wyvern ，回應《 評論｜ 最後一個公子：蔣萬安連任危機，與公子政治的黃昏 》 連勝文可以一剎間領先多位北市老將，是因為那粒子彈。4年後丁守中證明了他不比那位公子出色。 蔣萬安可以彈出，是在2016年那一個藍營大洪水時代，他是少數可以守住的立委。所以比其他2020年甚至2024年後才當選的立委優先出選。 4. 月的轨迹 ，回應《 出國打工的中國年輕人，在日本跌入「技能實習」困局 》 我也是长期生活在日本，我以为在日元长期贬值的情况下，技能实习对中国人吸引力应该很低了，没想到还是活跃黑产，让我很震惊。技能实习是现代奴隶制度我也以为早就是臭名昭著了，原来被中介包装的这么好😱！ 很佩服像刘星这样积极维权的人，以及支持团体坚持不懈的努力。众所周知现在的日本政府天天把外国人问题挂在嘴边，时不时拿来当政绩炫耀一下，真的非常需要这样外国人处境的深度报道，以及日本本国制度➕别国移民政策的深度比较分析。期待端持续关注这个话题。 5. ericchan ，回應《 「停止抱怨，做個真男人！」失去語言的男人們 》 最終她領悟：以她個人之力，其實是沒有辦法讓這些男性書友，嘗試著去為自己而活，那並不是她的使命 確實是如此。Carl Rogers的個人中心治療認為「每個人都是自己的專家」。作為他者，我們很難/基本不可能代替他人作出改變。但是這也不代表芊芊嘗試去做的事情沒有意義。向他人傾訴，在對話中釐清自身的感受也是慢慢鬆動自身一些maladaptive beliefs/schemas的過程。 而且即使是專業的諮商師也不可能自己說什麼來訪就能馬上作出改變的啊😂？ 專業的諮商師也會因為與來訪諮商感到耗竭。我覺得芊芊不需要對此感到罪惡感。這件事本就不是也不應是由你一個人承擔的責任，我覺得只需要在個人能力範圍以內多做一點就是一件很好的事。 6. koh ，回應《 「影子AI工作者」的秘密：AI提升效率，人類掩蓋痕跡 》 用AI創作最根本的倫理問題是在著作權，大語言模型裡海量的資料都是未經同意甚至暴力竊取而來的。這些資料經過AI公司"學習"之後就轉手出來賣錢，但作為原始資料的作者們一毛好處都拿不到，甚至會在市場上被同類競品擠壓。 這不是什麼手工對抗機器的問題，因為就算是用AI進行創作的人在這種環境也同樣無法避免被另一個用AI的人竊取成果。這種創作者無法受到著作權保護的世界，最後的贏家就只有掌握最多資源和AI技術的那些大公司而已。 桌上繪製了漫畫草稿的紙。攝：Philip Fong/AFP via Getty Images 7. 強詞奪理蘇偉榮 ，回應《 評論｜ 曖昧的蔡康永，與粗暴解讀下的政治現實 》 Well said "我認為在快速傳播敘事的時代，最值得警惕的是，眾多可能的解釋被壓縮成唯一的答案，而人們對答案的確信程度又遠遠超過證據所能支持的範圍，詮釋便開始取代事實，甚至取代了人們探求事實的能動力。" 非常精闢 8. listenchen ，回應《 「眼神給出去」的性商課，教的是媚男術，還是自我解放？ 》 有男性在參加的性商課嗎？還是男性參加的都是類似搭訕課？為什麼人們要選擇去討好與滿足這樣子的支配慾望跟佔有慾？為什麼不是以如何促進更好的對等、互動與情感連結關係去上所謂性商課？追根究底難道是因為男性的性喜好都是以這樣的方式被理解的嗎？身為男性我真覺得男性應該反省一下所謂來自‘’天性‘’的性偏好。 謝謝你的留言，據我了解這類性商課的受眾確實大多是女性。很難判斷對於這些學員的男性伴侶來說，性是不是最重要的擇偶標準，關係的破裂背後應該有各種複雜因素。我的感覺是，性商課提供了一套最簡單也最容易商業化的解釋方式，例如伴侶出軌說明你的性吸引力不夠，你可以透過上課來提升自己，修復關係。 學技巧很容易，但你提到的達成平等、情感聯結可能是最難的。為充滿不確定的關係建立了一種可控的解決途徑，或許這也是性商課有如此多受眾的原因。 特約撰稿人 譚衛紅 9. yunyin ，回應《 一個「好移民」能上街嗎？——10月17日之後的巴黎手記 》 謝謝分享在巴黎的感受，真的覺得社群上的某些討論好簡化和單一，有些即時新聞也很快的定調成「暴力抗爭」，台灣人真的很習慣無意識的要求社會運動要溫良恭儉讓，除非政府/警察的暴力已明目張膽，才願意接受一些些的回擊。 10. Esse ，回應《 解讀｜ 「銀鱈魚汞中毒」風波：被誤讀的是魚，還是吃魚的規則？ 》 脉络好清晰的科普文章，感谢作者和端（不禁想，在内地，这类关系到社会舆情的科普文章能在怎样的平台出现） 11. 真 ，回應《 中國式在家上學：短暫不輝煌 》 其實這就是學校體制需要改善，但學校不是家長開的，家長無權參與。其實就是沒有一個明確的系統可以確保每個孩子都被照顧到。我認為共生的系統其實比較可行，這樣有足夠資源的家長，可以進行一部分的自學，而不用完全脫離體制。 學校如果能多留一些時間給小孩，比方說學校半天，剩下的時間家庭保證能自學，也許也會是一個解方。 孩子們得學會自己使用自由的時間，但現在學校幾乎塞滿了學生應該要做的事情，常常忘了教育的本質其實不是讓每個孩子都“成功”。 也許這回到最基本的問題：我們這輩子到底要怎麼活？怎樣才能無怨無悔快樂生活？ 12. lnc ，回應《 評論｜ 從愛國公關到鐵拳公關，華為為什麼開始被批評？ 》 雖然很多人接受的所謂愛國教育已經把民族敘事、愛國這些概念內化成先驗的東西了。但敘事主體是國家、族群或政黨，而非企業。企業就應該在商言商，即使是所謂紅頂商人、民族企業或愛國企業家，也不會在宣傳產品的時候特意將政治屬性拿出來強調。即便企業掌舵人是人大政協，這些政治屬性很多時候只會在內部管治中作為平行的暗線存在，只在某些特殊時刻才會浮出來，目的通常也僅限於站隊表態表忠。 但華為卻把這些暗線的東西抬上來，由始至終地貫穿在產品營銷裡，並作為主要的營銷元素之一，這就已經足夠要提高警惕了。敘事主體變成了企業，甚至隱隱有不買就是不支持國產、就是不愛國的暗喻。產品本身的性能和品質反而被這樣的政治聲量蓋了下去，作為有點獨立思考能力的消費者都應該對這樣的宣發提高注意。 2019年5月29日，中國廣東深圳華為總部，一名員工正在為華為的新聞發布會做準備。攝：Jason Lee/Reuters/達志影像

title: 銀行倒閉拖垮總統：巴拉圭政局動盪如何牽動美中台角力？｜Whatsnew
summary: 11月3日，巴拉圭客戶數最多的Ueno銀行爆發金融危機倒閉，影響近300萬人口無法從帳戶中領取存款，民眾憤怒上街抗議。事件爆發後，總統潘尼亞（Santiago Peña）因與該銀行關係密切，6日遭到巴拉圭參議院全票通過彈劾並隨即遭到軟禁，總統一職由副總統、52 歲保守派政治人物阿里亞納（Pedro Alliana）宣誓接任。 巴拉圭的政權移轉與金融醜聞引發國際關注。巴拉圭是南美洲唯一目前仍與台灣維持正式邦交的國家，長期與北京保持距離，而前總統潘尼亞又與美國特朗普政府關係密切。
content: 11月3日，巴拉圭客戶數最多的Ueno銀行爆發金融危機倒閉，影響近300萬人口無法從帳戶中領取存款，民眾憤怒上街抗議。事件爆發後，總統潘尼亞（Santiago Peña）因與該銀行關係密切，6日遭到巴拉圭參議院全票通過彈劾並隨即遭到軟禁，總統一職由副總統、52 歲保守派政治人物阿里亞納（Pedro Alliana）宣誓接任。 巴拉圭的政權移轉與金融醜聞引發國際關注。巴拉圭是南美洲唯一目前仍與台灣維持正式邦交的國家，長期與北京保持距離，而前總統潘尼亞又與美國特朗普政府關係密切。近年來，美中在南美洲的外交與經貿競爭日趨激烈，中國持續擴大對該地區的投資與貿易影響力，積極爭取巴拉圭轉向，將之視為切斷台灣在南美最後據點的關鍵一步。因此，巴拉圭政局動盪是否牽動其對台、對中政策，也成為地緣政治觀察的焦點。 新任總統阿里亞納上台之後，美國國務卿魯比奧（Marco Rubio）也 祝賀 其接任總統，並稱美國致力於與巴拉圭人民建立牢固持久的伙伴關係；台灣外交部發言人蕭光偉也表示，台巴關係良好，巴拉圭的政局改變不會影響兩國邦誼，將擇期邀請新總統赴台。 2026年11月9日，巴拉圭首都亞松森，透過在抗議政府和Ueno Bank的示威中被砸碎的窗戶，可以看到Ueno Bank關閉後的辦公室內部。攝：Jorge Saenz/AP/達志影像 銀行倒閉引發的政治危機 綜合 美聯社 與 路透社 報導，11月3日，巴拉圭中央銀行決定將Ueno銀行置於破產管理程序之中，理由是該銀行償債能力比率（衡量資本與風險加權資產比率的指標）已跌至法定最低標準的一半以下。根據該銀行資料，Ueno擁有約近300萬客戶，占巴國650萬成年人口的六成；並管理8億至8.5億美元的公共資金。其中包括巴拉圭國家退休和醫療基金投資的約3.8億美元。 巴拉圭檢調第一時間下令逮捕該銀行的高層，包含 Ueno銀行的行長以及CEO一共八人。時任總統潘尼亞在第一時間 表示 ，已經要求巴國央行行長Carlos Carvallo辭職，並加速對客戶及公共資金的返還。他在社群媒體上發布貼文表示：「所有責任人都必須接受法院的審判，沒有任何例外或特權。」 然而，潘尼亞與Ueno銀行的母集團Grupo Vázquez的關係一直遭受質疑，他長期持有Vázquez的股份，直到2025年3月才售出； Carlos Carvallo的職務也是由潘尼亞所任命，他此前正是Ueno銀行的行長，此舉曾被控違反利益迴避原則。 根據 半島電視台 報導，Ueno銀行成立於1976年，本來在巴拉圭屬於小型金融機構，但在潘尼亞上任以後取得正式銀行執照，並進行了品牌重塑，在五年內迅速發展成為擁有70多家分行的銀行。 巴拉圭媒體《ABC Color》 報導 ，Ueno銀行遭到調查，起因為監管人員發現，該銀行向其母集團Grupo Vázquez的相關公司發放了1.46億美元的高風險貸款，且帳務的計算有誤，在校正過後發現緩衝資金不足法定限額的一半。 潘尼亞在上任前是國際貨幣基金（IMF）的經濟學家，巴拉圭也憑藉著近年來的低稅收、寬鬆的監管和穩定的經濟記錄吸引了外國投資者，2024年首次獲得信評機構穆迪（Moody’s）的投資級信用評級。自上任以來，潘尼亞也將自己塑造成國家與執政黨的改革者。他所屬的全國共和協會（Asociación Nacional Republicana），通常被稱為紅黨（Colorado Party），該黨自1947年以來長期執政，僅於2008年至2013在野，前後累計執政74年。 金融危機爆發後不久的11月5日，潘尼亞透過社群媒體 宣布 辭職，報導 指出 ，潘尼亞失去了紅黨重要領袖、參議員也是前總統的卡提斯（ Horacio Cartes ）支持；先前潘尼亞是在卡提斯的推舉之下參選總統。然而即便主動辭職，參議院仍舊選擇完成總統彈劾程序。最後在6日，巴國參議院以44:0（參議員共45人，1人缺席）通過潘尼亞的彈劾案，讓這位前總統喪失終身參議員的資格，以及刑事豁免權。 在彈劾程序通過以後，副總統阿里亞納宣誓繼任總統，潘尼亞也隨即被軟禁。 報導 指出，他被控利用總統職權，將數百萬美元政府存款存入Ueno；儘管已被告知這家銀行有可疑放款及償付能力問題，他仍隱瞞或淡化該行的財務困境。 另外，潘尼亞位於首都亞松森郊外的豪宅也遭到調查。潘尼亞2024年向該行成功申請2筆貸款，總額約50萬美元，用於興建這棟住宅；潘尼亞每月房貸還款金額高達3萬8000美元，相當於他擔任總統月薪的6倍。 2026年11月4日，巴拉圭首都亞松森，民眾在警察面前抗議政府和 Ueno Bank 。Ueno Bank因償付能力危機而被巴拉圭中央銀行接管。攝：Jorge Saenz/AP/達志影像 潘尼亞所面臨的指控還包含洗錢、資產來源不明（Illicit enrichment）、操弄金融監管機制、挪用退休基金等罪名，但潘尼亞本人否認一切不法的指控。 法新社 報導，阿里亞納上任以後，承諾不會放棄近300萬受上野銀行收購影響的儲戶，包括領退休金的人。並陸續在5日開始有條件發放「補償金額」；然而根據報導，是否能完全返還所有款項，以及資金來源等問題都未能釐清，也引起懷疑。 這場金融危機讓數千人走上街頭抗議，甚至連巴拉圭的足球也受到影響，因為Grupo Vázquez集團是多支球隊乃至於國家隊的主要贊助商，該國在阿根廷的分公司也停職30天且不支薪。 巴拉圭居民的反應 巴拉圭居民Lucía（化名）接受《端傳媒》訪問時表示，雖然自己沒有受到這次事件的影響，但巴拉圭社會整體相當驚嚇與手足無措。她認為，即便政府正在努力償還Ueno銀行留下的債務，但金額太過龐大，政府難以完全付清。 「潘尼亞與Grupo Vázquez需要出面負責，尤其如果潘尼亞的貪汙罪名確定——說實在的，也很難讓人相信潘尼亞沒有貪汙，他的支出是當總統月薪的六倍。」Lucía說。 她也提到，這起事件不只影響帳面上近300萬名儲戶那麼簡單——還包括失業的銀行人員、整個國家的商業活動等。她舉例，在她工作的地方，所有的商業合作案、專案計畫等已經全部暫停。 更嚴重的是，Lucía認為人民很難再次建立對政府的信任。這並非巴拉圭第一次有銀行倒閉，上一次是在1990年代末期到2000年初。此外，巴拉圭近年來是快速成長的經濟體，「外國的投資者如何有信心到巴拉圭投資？政府已經喪失了信用（Credibility），不只是外國資本，還有巴拉圭國民。」 至於會不會影響到2028總統選舉，她認為會，也希望會。「巴拉圭人也要想一想，我們已經被The Partido Colorado（紅黨）執政太久，但他們卻不斷貪汙，包含卡提斯、以及潘尼亞。」 2026年1月22日：美國總統特朗普在瑞士達沃斯舉行的第56屆世界經濟論壇期間，與巴拉圭總統潘尼亞在加薩和平憲章簽署儀式上握手。攝：Harun Ozalp/Anadolu via Getty Images 政治動盪成地緣政治焦點 根據《金融時報》 報導 ，潘尼亞是川普的堅定盟友之一。2024年，時任參議員的魯比奧曾經公開讚賞巴拉圭是南美洲的「榜樣」。川普也在上任之後，取消了前任總統拜登（Joe Biden）對巴拉圭前總統卡提斯所實施的制裁。制裁原因包括妨礙跨國犯罪調查、侵蝕民主制度、與真主黨有往來等。美國政府拒絕卡提斯與其子女入境，也凍結他在美國的資金與財產。 CNN 報導 指出，潘尼亞有許多施政措施都與川普保持一致，尤其在移民與安全問題的層面。潘尼亞曾透過國防和區域協調的協議與川普政府建立了牢固的關係，例如允許將來自美國的尋求庇護者轉移到巴拉圭的「安全第三國」協議。 美國「第三國遣返」計畫曝光：2.5萬移民被送往何處、又遭遇什麼？ 巴黎非營利新聞組織報導，特朗普第二屆政府快速擴大的「第三國遣返」網絡，如何將至少2.5萬移民送往原籍國以外的國家。遣送程序多有缺失，也可能違反國際法「不遣返原則」特朗普政府已與35個國家促成此類協議，至少投入4.1億美元。 美國與中國近年來在南美洲有激烈的外交競爭，已有多家研究機構包含 Brookings Institution 、 Council on Foreign Relations （CFR）的研究表明，中國在南美洲的經濟影響力已經超過美國，選擇與中國保持距離的巴拉圭，有其政治意義與獨特性。 專注於研究美洲地緣政治的非營利組織Global Americans執行長Diego Area 分析 指出，近期美巴關係大多依賴川普與潘尼亞的私人關係，巴拉圭政府也可以藉此表明雙邊關係並非僅有政治層面，而是在反貪腐層面上進行主動的合作，包括主動提供Ueno銀行案件的資訊。 巴拉圭政治顧問Sebastian Acha則認為，這起事件讓卡提斯重新在紅黨掌權，與美國維持關係的大方向會維持不變，但仍需觀察是否變成紅黨的政治清洗，以及2028總統大選前內部權力紛爭。而值得讚許的是，巴拉圭在24小時內讓總統下台，完成和平的權力交接，並未有軍事干預，這讓巴拉圭的盟友打消一定程度的疑慮。 巴拉圭與台灣 台灣與巴拉圭於1957年建交至今，雙方互設大使館。巴拉圭的長期執政黨立場親台，潘尼亞本人在2023年當選後，3年內已經訪台3次，最近一次是2026年5月。台灣也與巴拉圭有許多合作計畫，並採購農牧產品，根據外交部 資料 ，台灣目前是巴拉圭牛肉出口的第二大貿易夥伴、豬肉外銷的第一大採購國。 2026年5月8日，巴拉圭總統潘尼亞到訪台灣，與台灣總統賴清德一起出席歡迎儀式。攝：Ann Wang/Reuters/達志影像 然而，在台灣與中國的外交競爭下，邦交國每到選舉時，外交是否應該轉向中國都會成為討論焦點之一。2023年，潘尼亞的競爭對手、反對派候選人 Efraín Alegre就數度在接受媒體 訪問 時，主張要重新檢視與台灣的關係，並考慮與中國建立外交關係，原因是巴國的農牧業無法進入中國市場。 中國對於巴拉圭國會議員的拉攏手段也從未停歇，路透社3月的調查 指出 ，自2023年底以來，至少有19名巴拉圭國會議員、5名記者，以及一名具有總統參選意向的反對派政治人物訪問中國，且2025年訪問活動明顯增加，並且執政黨與在野黨都有人士參與。 對於巴拉圭政權交接後的後續情形，台灣外交部發言人蕭光偉 回應 ，巴國政情發展不會影響兩國邦誼及相關合作推動，新任總統阿里亞納堅定支持台灣，在擔任副總統與眾議院議長期間，多次公開重申台灣是巴拉圭重要戰略盟友。 阿里亞納原訂於11月24日訪問台灣，蕭光偉也說明，因情勢關係，阿里亞納就任總統，在此情況下會優先處理國政，後續會擇適當時機，再邀請他來台。 蕭光偉也說明，台灣在當地的援助計畫與業務往來的合作經費並未受到Ueno銀行倒閉影響，業務一切正常。

title: Jensen Huang’s resignation from Nvidia won’t end his problems with Congress
zh_title: 黄仁勋从英伟达辞职并不能解决他与国会的问题
summary: 黄仁勋可能已经离开了英伟达，但围绕他与一名中国间谍嫌疑人的关系以及这对美国国家安全可能意味着什么的问题只会变得越来越严重。这位亿万富翁周四的辞职并没有平息这一丑闻，该丑闻有可能波及英伟达董事会之外的范围，引发人们对特朗普政府放松对中国人工智能芯片销售限制的有争议决定的质疑。黄在制定这些政策方面发挥了重要作用。现在，国会想知道他与一家中国企业的个人关系是否
content:
黄仁勋可能已经离开了英伟达，但围绕他与一名中国间谍嫌疑人的关系以及这对美国国家安全可能意味着什么的问题只会变得越来越严重。这位亿万富翁周四的辞职并没有平息这一丑闻，该丑闻有可能波及英伟达董事会之外的范围，引发人们对特朗普政府放松对中国人工智能芯片销售限制的有争议决定的质疑。黄在制定这些政策方面发挥了重要作用。现在，国会想知道他与一名中国女商人的个人关系是否向北京泄露了敏感的美国技术或国家安全信息，以及政府官员对潜在风险的了解。据报道，尽管黄仁勋辞去了英伟达董事长兼首席执行官的职务，但他已同意在国会调查人员面前作证。这位前首席执行官和立法者一直在讨论闭门听证会的时间，这可能会解答他与一家涉嫌向中国人工智能实验室输送受限制的英伟达芯片的公司高管之间的关系。众议院的三名共和党委员会主席——众议员。 Brian Mast、John Moolenaar 和 Rick Crawford 在 11 月 4 日的一封信中要求黄提供证词，此时距他辞职还有一周多时间。
马斯特周四告诉记者，他的委员会仍然希望与黄进行对话，并补充说，他的工作人员最近在周三晚上就与黄的团队取得了联系。当天晚些时候，彭博社和 NBC 新闻报道称，黄已同意在没有传票的情况下出庭。在提出这一请求之前，《纽约时报》于 10 月 29 日对黄与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的关系进行了调查。一年多来，美国情报部门一直怀疑这家公司与中国政府合作，帮助将受贸易限制的人工智能芯片输送到中国实验室。议员们担心黄爱丽可能还向北京提供了获取商业机密和敏感国家安全信息的渠道。主席们写道：“最近的报告对中华人民共和国获取美国敏感技术和信息提出了重大的国家安全担忧。” “中国渗透和获取美国尖端技术的问题是本届国会三个委员会调查工作的核心。国会确定美国国家安全面临风险的程度至关重要。”特朗普也可能受到牵连，但国会的审查不再局限于黄仁勋或英伟达。立法者越来越多地询问特朗普政府是否忽视了有关中国潜在间谍活动的警告，同时允许该公司扩大对中国的先进人工智能芯片的销售。
11 月 11 日，民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 和克里斯·库恩斯 (Chris Coons) 致信商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)、国务卿马可·鲁比奥 (Marco Rubio) 和白宫幕僚长斯蒂芬·米勒 (Stephen Miller)，要求政府保留有关 Nvidia 芯片出口、可疑情报行动以及政府对 Megaspeed 调查的文件。参议员们特别要求提供有关据报道在特朗普 2026 年 5 月访问中国之前分发给高级政府官员的情报备忘录的记录。他们还寻求黄与特朗普之间的沟通、有关芯片出口限制的讨论记录以及有关政府汉密尔顿的文件。

【原文 English Original】
Jensen Huang may be out at Nvidia , but the questions surrounding his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy—and what it might have meant for American national security—are only growing more serious. The billionaire’s resignation Thursday has done little to quiet a scandal that threatens to reach well beyond Nvidia’s boardroom, raising questions about the Trump administration’s controversial decisions to loosen restrictions on AI chip sales to China. Huang played an influential role in shaping those policies. Now, Congress wants to know whether his personal relationship with a Chinese businesswoman exposed sensitive American technology or national security information to Beijing—and what government officials knew about the potential risks. Despite his departure as Nvidia’s chairman and CEO, Huang has reportedly agreed to testify before congressional investigators. The former CEO and lawmakers have been discussing the timing of the closed-door hearing, which could provide answers about his relationship with an executive at a company suspected of funneling restricted Nvidia chips to Chinese AI labs. Three Republican committee chairs in the House of Representatives—Reps. Brian Mast, John Moolenaar, and Rick Crawford—requested Huang’s testimony in a November 4 letter , more than a week before his resignation. Mast told reporters Thursday that his committee still wanted to speak to Huang, adding that his staff had been in contact with Huang’s team as recently as Wednesday night. Later that day, Bloomberg and NBC News reported that Huang had agreed to appear without a subpoena. The request followed an October 29 New York Times investigation into Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at Megaspeed, a company U.S. intelligence had suspected for more than a year of collaborating with the Chinese government and helping funnel trade-restricted AI chips to Chinese labs. The lawmakers are concerned that Alice Huang may also have provided Beijing with access to trade secrets and sensitive national security information. “Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC’s (People’s Republic of China) access to sensitive U.S. technology and information,” the chairmen wrote. “The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge U.S. technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress. It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which U.S. national security has been placed at risk.” Trump could be implicated, too But the congressional scrutiny is no longer limited to Huang or Nvidia. Lawmakers are increasingly asking whether the Trump administration overlooked warnings about potential Chinese espionage while allowing the company to expand sales of advanced AI chips to China. On November 11, Democratic Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Coons sent a letter to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller demanding that the administration preserve documents concerning Nvidia’s chip exports, the suspected intelligence operation, and government investigations into Megaspeed. The senators specifically requested records concerning an intelligence memorandum reportedly circulated to senior administration officials ahead of Trump’s May 2026 visit to China. They also sought communications between Huang and Trump, records of discussions about chip export restrictions, and documents concerning the government’s handling of its investigation into Megaspeed. The question, at the core of their inquiry, is whether national security concerns were sidelined as Huang and the Trump administration pursued policies that benefited Nvidia. Huang has been one of the tech industry’s most prominent supporters of Donald Trump. Nvidia contributed $1 million to Trump’s inaugural fund and $25 million toward the White House ballroom now under construction. Huang himself has visited Trump’s Mar-a-Lago resort in Florida and the White House numerous times, and has traveled with the president. His influence on U.S. export policy regarding AI chips is evident. He’s credited with persuading the Trump administration to allow sales of Nvidia H20 and H200 chips to China. Huang argued that letting the chips, and the CUDA software framework that runs them, proliferate around the world was good for America. Nvidia also agreed to pay the U.S. government 15% of revenue from H20 sales and 25% from H200 sales. Nvidia defended the arrangement last December. “The Administration’s licensing process will ensure that sales of H200 to authorized customers worldwide do not deprive U.S. customers of anything—and will in fact benefit American national and economic security,” spokesman John Rizzo said in a statement to Fast Company . “Offering H200 to approved and known commercial customers, vetted by the Department of Commerce, raises no cybersecurity risk and strikes a thoughtful balance that is great for America.” Those assurances now face renewed scrutiny. Megaspeed bought billions of dollars’ worth of Nvidia chips in recent years, including some of its most powerful Blackwell chips, which remain off limits to Chinese labs. A New York Times report last year described finding boxes of powerful Nvidia chips at a nearly empty Megaspeed office in Malaysia, raising suspicions that the company was serving as a conduit for restricted technology bound for China. There are also unanswered questions about the government’s response. The Commerce Department opened an investigation into Megaspeed last year, but the inquiry was subsequently transferred to the Department of Justice, with little publicly known about what happened afterward. The Warren–Coons letter seeks records that could help establish what senior Trump administration officials knew about the suspected Chinese intelligence operation, why the White House and the Commerce Department allowed chip shipments to Megaspeed to continue, and whether or not the White House disregarded national security recommendations to accommodate Nvidia’s commercial interests. These questions could become more consequential when Democrats take control of Congress in January. Coons, who is expected to chair the powerful Senate Foreign Relations Committee, has also called for an investigation into Huang and Nvidia to determine whether national security was compromised while Nvidia and the White House benefited financially from chip sales to China. “We need answers about the relationship between AI billionaires and the Trump administration,” Coons wrote on X . I’m pushing to investigate Jensen Huang and Nvidia to determine whether our national security was compromised. We need answers about the relationship between AI billionaires and the Trump administration, who's making these decisions, and who's really got their hand on the wheel. — Senator Chris Coons (@ChrisCoons) November 9, 2026 For Nvidia, meanwhile, the immediate consequences have been severe. Its shares have lost nearly a quarter of their value—24.6%—since The New York Times first reported on Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang on October 29. Nvidia has not publicly offered a detailed explanation for accepting Huang’s resignation. Its SEC filing simply states that the board accepted his departure. But the decision may have had less to do with the morality of Huang’s personal conduct than with the growing financial and political risks of keeping him in charge.

title: Hong Kong 2019 protest prosecutions ‘no barrier’ to BN(O) visa route, UK home secretary confirms
zh_title: 英国内政大臣证实，2019 年香港抗议起诉对 BN(O) 签证途径“不构成障碍”
summary: 英国内政大臣证实，因参加 2019 年香港民主抗议活动而受到的起诉不会阻止其他符合资格的申请人获得英国国家（海外）签证途径。英国议会大厦，威斯敏斯特，伦敦。资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。英国人权联合委员会寻求澄清，因为担心因与 2019 年示威和骚乱有关的罪行而被定罪的具有 BN(O) 身份的人可能会被拒绝入境或留下来。周三，内政大臣沙巴纳·马哈茂德回复了一封信
content:
英国内政大臣证实，因参加 2019 年香港民主抗议活动而受到的起诉不会阻止其他符合资格的申请人获得英国国家（海外）签证途径。英国议会大厦，威斯敏斯特，伦敦。资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。英国人权联合委员会寻求澄清，因为担心因与 2019 年示威和骚乱有关的罪行而被定罪的具有 BN(O) 身份的人可能会被拒绝入境或留下来。周三，内政大臣沙巴纳·马哈茂德回复了委员会的一封信。她写道：“现在应该有一个假设，即确保与参加 2019 年抗议活动相关的定罪不会妨碍其他符合资格的个人从 BN(O) 路线中受益。因参加亲民主抗议活动而不符合标准 BN(O) 路线适用性要求的 BN(O) 路线申请人现在将自动被部长考虑在移民规则之外授予休假资格。”她补充说：“我感到自豪的是，英国已经为数千名香港人提供了安全港，政府将继续与香港人民站在一起。” 2019 年 12 月 8 日的抗议活动。照片：May James/HKFP。 2019 年 6 月，针对已被废除的引渡法案爆发了抗议活动。
在呼吁民主和对北京的侵犯感到愤怒的背景下，他们有时升级为对警察行为的暴力表达。示威者要求对警察行为进行独立调查，赦免被捕者，并停止将抗议活动定性为“骚乱”。  7月下旬，前民主党主席胡志伟抵达英国后在伦敦希思罗机场被拦截，在边境被拘留10小时后最初仅获得7天的移民保释。胡志伟在 2019 年的抗议活动中。照片：FTVV 截图。吴根据北京实施的国家安全法因阴谋颠覆国家而被定罪。他是被指控在 2020 年 7 月举行非官方民主立法会初选的 47 名民主党人之一。这位 63 岁的人被判入狱四年零五个月。英国当局后来批准他在该国居留六个月。已签发超过 230,000 份签证 人权联合委员会是一个议会小组，由来自下议院和上议院任命的 12 名成员组成。根据周三的新闻稿，人权联合委员会主席亚历克斯·索贝尔 (Alex Sobel) 表示：“BN(O) 路线的设立是专门为了确保英国能够成为那些因捍卫民主自由而受到不公正惩罚的人的庇护所。他们因参加抗议活动而被定罪，不应阻止人们参与这一计划。”
政府认识到这个问题并采取适当的行动来纠正它是正确的。”上周，英国表示，在英国的香港 BN(O) 签证持有者将不受一项将定居资格期限加倍至 10 年的提议的豁免。香港人的签证计划是在北京于 2020 年颁布香港国安法后推出的。据内政部称，截至今年 2 月，已有超过 23 万人获得了 BN(O) 签证，近 17 万人移居英国。北京于2020年6月将国家安全立法直接纳入香港小宪法

【原文 English Original】
Britain’s home secretary has confirmed that prosecutions for taking part in the 2019 pro-democracy protests in Hong Kong will not prevent otherwise eligible applicants from accessing the British National (Overseas) visa route. The UK Houses of Parliament, Westminster, London. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. The UK’s Joint Committee on Human Rights had sought the clarification amid concerns that people with BN(O) status convicted of offences connected to the 2019 demonstrations and unrest could be denied entry or leave to remain. On Wednesday, Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood responded to a letter from the committee. She wrote: “[T]here should now be a presumption in favour of ensuring that convictions connected to participation in the 2019 protests do not prevent otherwise eligible individuals from benefiting from the BN(O) route. BN(O) route applicants who do not meet the standard BN(O) route suitability requirements due to participation in the pro-democracy protests will now be automatically considered by Ministers for a grant of leave outside the Immigration Rules.” “I am proud that the UK has already provided a safe haven to thousands of Hong Kongers and the Government will continue to stand with the people of Hong Kong,” she added. A protest on December 8, 2019. Photo: May James/HKFP. Protests erupted in June 2019 over a since-axed extradition bill . They escalated into sometimes violent displays of dissent against police behaviour, amid calls for democracy and anger over Beijing’s encroachment. Demonstrators demanded an independent probe into police conduct, amnesty for those arrested and a halt to the characterisation of protests as “riots.”  In late July, ex-Democratic Party chair Wu Chi-wai was stopped at London’s Heathrow Airport upon arriving in the UK and initially granted only seven days of immigration bail following a 10-hour detention at the border. Wu Chi-wai at the 2019 protests. Photo: FTVV screenshot. Wu was convicted under the Beijing-imposed national security law for conspiracy to subvert the state. He was among 47 democrats accused of holding an unofficial pro-democracy legislative primary election in July 2020. The 63-year-old was jailed for four years and five months. UK authorities later granted him leave to remain in the country for six months. Over 230,000 visas issued The Joint Committee on Human Rights is a parliamentary group of 12 members appointed from both the House of Commons and the House of Lords. According to a Wednesday press release, Chair of the Joint Committee on Human Rights Alex Sobel said: “The BN(O) route was set up specifically to ensure that the UK could be a place of sanctuary to those who were unjustly punished for standing up for their democratic freedoms. Convictions they received for taking part in the protests should not preclude people from accessing this scheme. It is right that the Government has recognised this issue and taken the appropriate action to remedy it.” Last week, the UK said Hong Kong BN(O) visa holders in the UK would be exempt from a proposal to double the qualifying period for settlement to 10 years. The visa scheme for Hongkongers was introduced following the 2020 enactment of the Beijing-imposed security law in the city. As of February this year, over 230,000 people had been granted a BN(O) visa and almost 170,000 had moved to the UK, according to the Home Office. Beijing inserted national security legislation directly into Hong Kong’s mini-constitution in June 2020 following a year of pro-democracy protests and unrest. It criminalised subversion, secession, collusion with foreign forces and terrorist acts – broadly defined to include disruption to transport and other infrastructure. The move gave police sweeping new powers and led to hundreds of arrests amid new legal precedents , while dozens of civil society groups disappeared . The authorities say it restored stability and peace to the city, rejecting criticism from trade partners , the UN and NGOs .

title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang: US media
zh_title: 美媒：英伟达准备罢免CEO黄仁勋
summary: 美国媒体周三报道称，英伟达董事会正准备罢免其联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋，因为该芯片巨头的首席执行官在被曝与一名被指控为中国从事间谍活动的女性有染后，面临新的不忠指控。 Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2026 年 1 月 5 日在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的年度消费电子展之前，在 CES 2026 的 Nvidia Live 上发表讲话。照片：Patrick T. Fallon/法新社。据《华尔街日报》援引知情人士的消息称，该科技公司董事会正准备最快于周三召开会议，以确定黄的未来。
content:
美国媒体周三报道称，英伟达董事会正准备罢免其联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋，因为该芯片巨头的首席执行官在被曝与一名被指控为中国从事间谍活动的女性有染后，面临新的不忠指控。 Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2026 年 1 月 5 日在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的年度消费电子展之前，在 CES 2026 的 Nvidia Live 上发表讲话。照片：Patrick T. Fallon/法新社。据《华尔街日报》援引知情人士的话称，该科技公司董事会正准备最快于周三召开会议，以确定黄的未来。 《纽约时报》周三报道称，黄还与一名下属发生了第二次婚外情，称有视频证据显示这位 63 岁的高管与英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 关系密切。据《泰晤士报》报道，48 岁的鲍威尔一直是英伟达努力将芯片技术扩展到高等教育和医疗保健领域的公开代言人，他在加利福尼亚州圣何塞举行的一次会议上发表了讲话，旁观者“看到他们在酒店里充满感情”。在报道第二起事件之前，黄承认与新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的高级管理人员 Alice Huang 存在关系。 《华尔街日报》报道称，两人曾于2024年和2025年在台北被拍到在一起。
Nvidia 创始人、总裁兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 4 月 30 日在华盛顿特区举行的 2025 年 Hill & Valley 论坛上。照片：The Hill and Valley 论坛，来自 YouTube。据报道，美国情报部门去年春天散发了一份备忘录，指控黄爱丽是中国国家安全部的资产。这位英伟达首席执行官在周日给英伟达员工的一封信中承认与黄仁勋有关系——他与黄仁勋没有任何亲属关系——并写道：“我对我的妻子不忠。”同一天，英伟达董事会在一份声明中表示，他们“根据最近有关创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报工作目标的报道，启动了一项独立调查”。另请参阅：英伟达首席执行官事件再次推动美国对中国采取更强硬立场“我支持调查并将全力配合。我爱我们的国家和我们的公司，”黄在声明中写道。据《泰晤士报》报道，国会还要求他就他与爱丽丝黄的互动提供闭门简报。随着人工智能行业的蓬勃发展，英伟达的股价再创新高，黄仁勋在白宫活动中出现在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普身边，就在上个月，他接受了共和党领导人颁发的国家科学奖章。 2025 年 4 月 30 日星期三，在白宫十字厅举行的“投资美国”活动中，NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋在唐纳德·特朗普总统的注视下发表讲话。
照片：白宫，来自 Flickr.Huang 是世界上最有影响力的科技领袖之一，其中包括埃隆·马斯克、杰夫·贝索斯和马克·扎克伯格，他们誓言要对人工智能进行自我监管，以应对可能的威胁，而特朗普拒绝了政府监管的呼吁，并驳回了该技术可能消灭人类的警告。英伟达股东对黄仁勋和这家人工智能芯片制造商提起集体诉讼，理由是他们未能向投资者披露有关双方关系的信息。自黄仁勋承认此事以来，英伟达股价近几天暴跌。 Nvidia 设计先进组件起源

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia’s board is preparing to oust its co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang, US media reported Wednesday, as the chip giant’s chief faces new accusations of infidelity, after revelations he had an affair with a woman accused of spying for China. Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang speaks during Nvidia Live at CES 2026 ahead of the annual Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas, Nevada, on January 5, 2026. Photo: Patrick T. Fallon/AFP. The tech company’s board was preparing to meet as soon as Wednesday to determine Huang’s future, according to the Wall Street Journal, which quoted people familiar with the matter. The New York Times reported Wednesday that Huang was also involved in a second extramarital affair, with a subordinate, saying there was video evidence of the 63-year-old executive being affectionate with Nvidia’s vice president of health care, Kimberly Powell. Powell, 48, has been a public face of Nvidia’s efforts to expand the chip technology into higher education and health care, and was speaking at a San Jose, California conference where they “were seen being affectionate at the hotel” by bystanders, the Times reported. The report of the second affair follows Huang’s acknowledgment of a relationship with Alice Huang, a senior executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed. The Wall Street Journal reported that the two were photographed together in Taipei in 2024 and 2025. Nvidia founder, president and CEO Jensen Huang at the Hill & Valley Forum 2025 in Washington, DC, on April 30, 2025. Photo: The Hill and Valley Forum, via YouTube. US intelligence reportedly circulated a memo this past spring alleging Alice Huang was an asset of China’s Ministry of State Security. The Nvidia CEO admitted to having had a relationship with Huang — to whom he bears no familial relation — in a note to Nvidia employees Sunday, writing: “I was unfaithful to my wife.” The same day Nvidia’s board of directors said in a statement that they’d launched “an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.” See also: Nvidia CEO affair revives push for tougher US line on China “I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company,” Huang wrote in his statement. He has also been called on by Congress to provide a closed-door briefing on his interactions with Alice Huang, the Times reported. As the artificial intelligence industry surge has spurred Nvidia’s stock prices to new heights, Huang has appeared at US President Donald Trump’s side at White House events, as recently as last month when he accepted a National Medal of Science from the Republican leader. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang delivers remarks as President Donald Trump looks on during an “Investing in America” event, Wednesday, April 30, 2025, in the Cross Hall of the White House. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Huang was among the world’s most influential tech leaders — including Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos and Mark Zuckerberg — who vowed to self-regulate AI against possible threats, as Trump rejected calls for government oversight and dismissed warnings the technology could wipe out humanity. Nvidia shareholders filed a class action lawsuit against Huang and the AI chip maker for failing to disclose information about the relationship to investors. Nvidia shares have plummeted in recent days since Huang admitted to the affair. Nvidia designs advanced components originally created to handle 3D visuals in video games, called Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). Nvidia’s processors are mostly made by Taiwanese company TSMC, the world’s largest contract manufacturer of chips.

content:
2026 年 6 月 30 日，在康涅狄格州格罗顿的新伦敦海军潜艇基地，弗吉尼亚级核动力快速攻击潜艇南达科他号 (SSN-790) 指挥变更仪式上，鸣放 11 响礼炮，迎接第 2 潜艇大队指挥官梅尔文·史密斯少将的到来。丹尼尔·古德温接替了中校的职务。伯恩斯·C·W·布朗 (Burnes C.W. Brown) 担任南达科他州指挥官。美国海军照片 美国海军照片 南达科他号航空母舰 (SSN-790) 的指挥三合会上个月因搁浅事件而被拆除，根据一名国会议员的声明。根据众议院海上力量和投送部队小组委员会高级成员乔·考特尼（康涅狄格州民主党人）众议员和众议院军事委员会高级成员亚当·史密斯（华盛顿州民主党人）周四发布的一封信，该潜艇的指挥官、执行官和艇长于 10 月 14 日被解除指挥权，据称此次解除是由于搁浅事件。指挥官。据康涅狄格州新伦敦《每日报》报道，丹·古德温被解除南达科他州指挥官职务。根据五角大楼发布的消息，古德温于 2026 年 6 月接任南达科他州指挥官。一位知情人士告诉美国海军学院新闻，在潜艇舵软接地后，三合会被移除。信中称，议员们从一名记者要求就解雇事件发表评论的请求中得知，他们松了口气。
近一个月后，众议院军事委员会尚未收到任何有关解雇或潜在事件的通知。 2026 年 6 月 30 日，在康涅狄格州格罗顿新伦敦海军潜艇基地的快速攻击潜艇码头上举行南达科他号 (SSN-790) 号航空母舰指挥变更仪式后，南达科他号 (SSN-790) 舰长丹尼尔·古德温被送上岸。致代理海军部长曹洪和海军作战部长达里尔·考德尔上将。海军通常会向国会通报海上事件、事故和指挥三合会的解散。 “海军缺乏透明度留下了许多悬而未决的问题，不仅涉及发生了什么，还涉及导致三合会解散的事件对南达科他州的结构健康、船员的福祉的影响，以及该事件是否暴露了必须解决的标准程序培训方面的任何系统性问题。由于海军未能沟通，本应成为信息共享的标准演习，反而引发了人们对海军对透明度的承诺以及对与国会建立富有成效的工作关系的承诺的质疑。”这封信。一名国防官员向美国海军学院新闻证实了这一消息。
海军发言人承认了美国海军学院新闻的提问，但没有立即发表评论。 目前尚不清楚南达科他州是否受损。南达科他号于 2019 年服役，是海军最先进的潜艇之一，也是新潜艇技术的试验台。美国海军学院新闻 2016 年报道称：“这艘船采用了使船舶更安静的涂层、更安静的喷水推进器以及安装在船体两侧的附加声纳，以提高船员探测敌方船只和潜艇的能力。”美国攻击潜艇上一次重大搁浅是在 2021 年。在南海执行任务时，美国海军康涅狄格号 (SSN-21) 与一艘水下潜艇相撞。

【原文 English Original】
11-gun salutes are fired for the arrival of Rear Adm. Melvin Smith, Commander, Submarine Group 2, during the Virginia-class nuclear-powered fast attack submarine USS South Dakota (SSN-790) Change of Command Ceremony at Naval Submarine Base New London in Groton, Connecticut, June 30, 2026. Cmdr. Daniel Goodwin relieved Cmdr. Burnes C.W. Brown as Commanding Officer of South Dakota. US Navy photo USS South Dakota (SSN-790) command triad was removed last month following a grounding incident, according to a statement from a member of Congress. The submarine’s commanding officer, executive officer and chief of the boat were relieved from command on Oct. 14, with the relief allegedly attributed to a grounding incident, according to a letter released Thursday by Reps. Joe Courtney (D-Conn.), Ranking Member of the House Seapower and Projection Forces Subcommittee, and Adam Smith (D-Wash.), Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Committee. Cmdr. Dan Goodwin was relieved as commander of South Dakota , according to a story in the Day newspaper based in New London, Conn. Goodwin assumed command of South Dakota in June of 2026, according to a Pentagon release . A source familiar told USNI News the triad removal followed a soft grounding of the submarine’s rudder. Lawmakers learned of the relief from a reporter’s request for comment on the dismissal, according to the letter. Nearly one month later, no notifications of the firings or the underlying incident had been made to the House Armed Services Committee. Cmdr. Daniel Goodwin, commanding officer of USS South Dakota (SSN-790) is piped ashore following the USS South Dakota (SSN-790) change of command ceremony that was held June 30, 2026, onboard the fast attack submarine pierside at Naval Submarine Base New London in Groton, Conn. US Navy photo “The Department of the Navy’s failure to communicate these incidents to Congress is unacceptable,” reads the letter, which is addressed to Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao and Chief of Naval Operations Adm. Daryl Caudle. The Navy typically informs Congress of at-sea incidents, accidents and dismissals of command triads. “The Navy’s lack of transparency leave many outstanding questions about not only what occurred, but the impact of the events leading the triad’s dismissal on the structural health of South Dakota , the well-being of the crew, and whether the incident laid bare any systemic issues with training to standard procedures that must be addressed. As a result of the Navy’s failure to communicate, what should have been a standard exercise in information sharing has instead raised questions about the Navy’s commitment to transparency and its commitment to a productive working relationship with Congress,” reads the letter. A defense official confirmed the removals to USNI News. A Navy spokesperson acknowledged a question from USNI News but did not immediately provide a comment. It’s unclear whether South Dakota was damaged. Commissioned in 2019, South Dakota is one of the Navy’s most advanced submarines and serves as the test bed for new submarine technology. “The boat received coatings that keep the ship quieter, a quieter water jet propulsor and additional sonars mounted on the sides of the hull to increase the crew’s ability to detect enemy ships and submarines,” USNI News reported in 2016 . The last major grounding of a U.S. attack submarine was in 2021. While operating in the South China Sea, USS Connecticut (SSN-21) collided with an underwater sea mount, resulting in extensive damage to the boat. The submarine is still undergoing repairs.

title: Russia’s Push for AI Sovereignty Faces Setbacks

content:
内容摘要：10 月份乌克兰无人机袭击俄罗斯，损坏了 Yandex、VK、Sberbank 和俄罗斯联邦税务局运营的数据中心，扰乱了数字服务，并引发了将基础设施从莫斯科地区搬迁到远东的讨论。随着人们越来越担心俄罗斯系统落后于美国和中国模式，莫斯科正在着手正式确定其人工智能（AI）政策。新的人工智能立法于 9 月生效。俄罗斯官员将国内人工智能视为国家主权问题，但计算基础设施和技术人员的短缺，以及外国人工智能模型的日益使用，威胁着莫斯科发展有竞争力的国内行业的努力。 10 月 8 日，乌克兰无人机袭击了俄罗斯最大科技公司 Yandex 旗下的大型数据中心之一，导致该公司在全国各地的服务大规模中断。罢工使该公司的云服务进入紧急模式，客户不得不将数据转移到其他云系统（Habr，10 月 12 日）。 Yandex 数字生态系统内的其他服务需要数周时间才能恢复（T-J，10 月 26 日）。
VK Company Limited 是另一家控制着领先的俄语社交媒体网站 VKontakte 和 Odnoklassniki、国家消息系统 Max 以及俄罗斯领先的电子邮件服务 Mail.ru 的大型科技公司，最近其数据中心也遭受了损害，俄罗斯最大的金融机构 Sberbank 也是如此（CNews，10 月 18 日）。这些攻击只是克里姆林宫在继续推动完全数字主权时面临的众多困难之一。这些 10 月份的攻击符合乌克兰无人机针对俄罗斯数据中心的更广泛模式，包括那些属于联邦组织的数据中心，例如下诺夫哥罗德的国家税务局（Nastoyashee Vremya，10 月 23 日）。 Ozon 是一家电子商务公司，被认为是俄罗斯的亚马逊，自 8 月以来一直面临着针对其仓库的无人机袭击（Omskinform，10 月 28 日）。这些攻击对俄罗斯发展安全和主权科技行业的努力产生了严重后果。俄罗斯科技行业正在呼吁加强安全性，一些人正在讨论将数据中心迁往远东的可能性，因为目前 75% 的商业数据中心位于莫斯科州（Techora，10 月 27 日）。技术媒体讨论的其他选择包括将数据中心移至哈萨克斯坦。 Yandex 尚未面临西方的全面制裁，使其有可能将基础设施转移到国外（Habr，10 月 12 日）。
对俄罗斯科技行业的物理攻击正值克里姆林宫越来越担心该国人工智能（AI）的未来。俄罗斯杜马成立了一个委员会来解决人工智能问题，由执政的统一俄罗斯党副秘书长、俄罗斯“外国代理人”法的发起人之一亚历山大·西迪亚金（Aleksandr Sidyakin）领导，该法名义上旨在减少外国在该国的影响力，并压制独立媒体、非政府组织和非系统性政治反对派（Meduza， 9 月 24 日）。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京表示，俄罗斯的主权将取决于该国开发自己的国内人工智能的能力（RBC，4 月 10 日）。人工智能在俄罗斯对乌克兰战争中的快速发展彻底改变了战场，减少了

【原文 English Original】
Executive Summary: Ukrainian drone strikes on Russia in October damaged data centers operated by Yandex, VK, Sberbank, and Russia’s Federal Tax Service, disrupting digital services and prompting discussion of relocating infrastructure from the Moscow region to the Far East. Moscow is moving to formalize its artificial intelligence (AI) policy as concerns grow that Russian systems are falling behind U.S. and Chinese models. New AI legislation entered into force in September. Russian officials view domestic AI as a matter of national sovereignty, but shortages of computing infrastructure and skilled personnel, alongside growing use of foreign AI models, threaten Moscow’s efforts to develop a competitive domestic sector. Ukrainian drone strikes on October 8 struck one of the large data centers belonging to Yandex, Russia’s largest tech company, leading to massive interruptions in the company’s services around the country. The strikes pushed the company’s cloud services into emergency mode, and clients had to move their data to other cloud systems ( Habr , October 12). Other services within the Yandex digital ecosystem required weeks to recover ( T-J , October 26). VK Company Limited—another major tech company which controls the leading Russian-language social media sites VKontakte and Odnoklassniki, the national messaging system Max, and Mail.ru, Russia’s leading e-mail service—also recently faced damage to its data centers, as did Sberbank, Russia’s largest financial institution ( CNews , October 18). These attacks underscore just one of the many difficulties facing the Kremlin as it continues to push for complete digital sovereignty. These October attacks fit into a broader pattern of Ukrainian drone strikes against Russian data centers, including those belonging to federal organizations, such as the National Tax Service in Nizhnyi Novgorod ( Nastoyashee Vremya , October 23). Ozon, an e-commerce company that is considered Russia’s answer to Amazon, has faced continued drone attacks targeting their warehouses since August ( Omskinform , October 28).  The attacks have had serious consequences for Russia’s attempts to develop a secure and sovereign tech sector. The Russian technology industry is calling for additional security, and some are discussing potentially relocating data centers to the Far East, as 75 percent of commercial data centers are currently located in Moscow oblast ( Techora , October 27). Other options discussed in the technology press include moving data centers to Kazakhstan. Yandex has not faced comprehensive Western sanctions, enabling it to potentially move infrastructure abroad ( Habr , October 12). The physical attacks on Russia’s technology sector come as the Kremlin becomes more concerned about the future of artificial intelligence (AI) in the country. The Russian Duma formed a committee to address AI issues, headed by Aleksandr Sidyakin, deputy secretary general of the ruling United Russia party and one of the initiators of Russia’s “foreign agents” law, which nominally aimed to reduce foreign influence in the country and suppressed independent media, non-governmental organizations, and non-systemic political opposition ( Meduza , September 24). Russian President Vladimir Putin has said that Russia’s sovereignty will depend on the country’s ability to develop its own domestic AI ( RBC , April 10). The rapid development of AI use in Russia’s war against Ukraine has completely altered the battlefield, reducing the applicability of lessons from previous wars, according to Russian Deputy Defense Minister General Yunus-Bek Evkurov in an August interview ( RBC , August 10). The first legislation specifying Kremlin policies for the development of domestic models entered into effect in September, though some provisions will not take effect until March 2027. “Sovereign” AI models must use only domestic technologies under the law, while “national” models can use foreign components and open-source solutions ( RBC , August 31). “Sovereign” models, according to Sidyakin, must “conform to Russian spiritual and moral values” ( RIA Novosti , October 27). Moscow is concerned that Russian AI is falling behind models from the United States and the People’s Republic of China (PRC). Sberbank President German Gref estimated that Russian AI was a half-year behind Beijing’s systems and expressed fears that this lag will continue ( RBC , September 24). This announcement followed news that PRC models were the second and third most popular models among Russian clients using domestic cloud platforms, with the use of PRC AI growing elevenfold year-on-year ( Kommersant , August 13). Surveys published in the summer found that respondents from 79 percent of 100 major Russian companies reported too few AI specialists and 91 percent lacked sufficient server infrastructure ( ITZine , July 29).  These concerns about AI development are compounded by evidence of brain drain. Arkadii Volozh, the original founder of Yandex, immigrated to the Netherlands in 2024 after criticizing Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, taking 1,000 engineers with him, along with plans to develop a company specializing in infrastructure for AI systems. His assets were then sold to Russian investors for $5.4 billion ( IncRussia , July 16). The Kremlin is subsidizing the development of domestic AI by offering tax breaks to small and medium enterprises that adopt domestic solutions, but the country will need 89,000 AI specialists by 2030, according to estimates presented at a tech conference by former Russian Deputy Prime Minister Dmitrii Gorgenko ( Vedomosti , September 21; Ekspert , October 24). The new AI legislation is part of a broader shift toward Russian digital sovereignty. This push includes a “sovereign” internet and national network defense system (see EDM , May 20). Russia faces serious challenges, including developing national AI systems that can compete with U.S. and PRC versions while protecting its technology infrastructure from Ukrainian strikes. Further attacks leading to extended online interruptions would likely undermine support for the war effort and disrupt Russia’s digital economy. A major relocation of technology infrastructure to the Far East would likely require heavy state support and the development of an ecosystem to support the data centers, both serious undertakings for an economy that is facing stagnation (see EDM , November 2).  The post Russia’s Push for AI Sovereignty Faces Setbacks appeared first on Jamestown .

title: 习近平为何清洗自己的人？——托里吉安谈恐惧、党性与接班政治
summary: 编按 2026 年 10 月下旬，约 300 名中共中央委员在北京闭门召开二十届五中全会，会议确认了数十名中央委员被除名。自 2022 年开始第三个任期以来，习近平对党内高层发动了毛泽东时代以来最彻底的清洗：中央军委领导成员几乎被清洗一空，除他本人外，只剩下主管调查工作的张升民；仅过去一年，就有三名政治局委员落马，其中包括他长期倚重的军委副主席张又侠。清洗为何走到这一步？美利坚大学教授托里吉安（Joseph Torigian）是习仲勋英文传记《党的利益高于一切》（The Pa
content: 编按 2026 年 10 月下旬，约 300 名中共中央委员在北京闭门召开二十届五中全会，会议确认了数十名中央委员被除名。自 2022 年开始第三个任期以来，习近平对党内高层发动了毛泽东时代以来最彻底的清洗：中央军委领导成员几乎被清洗一空，除他本人外，只剩下主管调查工作的张升民；仅过去一年，就有三名政治局委员落马，其中包括他长期倚重的军委副主席张又侠。清洗为何走到这一步？美利坚大学教授托里吉安（Joseph Torigian）是习仲勋英文传记《党的利益高于一切》（The Party’s Interests Come First）的作者。他在布鲁金斯学会的播客节目中给出的解释值得重视：在习近平的政治观念里，干部犯错从来不是能力或环境的问题，而是“政治觉悟”出了问题，是对事业失去了信仰，因此不能轻罚，只能清除。与毛时代不同的是，被清洗的人不再有平反的可能，“要么上升，要么彻底出局”，体制内的恐惧也因此更深。托里吉安同时提醒，观察 2027 年党代会前的接班政治，应当保持分析上的谦逊。斯大林和毛泽东身后的历史表明，接班斗争的胜出者未必是政策最得人心的人，结果往往取决于谁能操纵模糊的规则；而在规则模糊的时候，关键在于谁能调动军队和政治警察。 来源 The Beijing Brief 播客第 18 期：“Why is Xi Jinping purging leaders of his own party?”，布鲁金斯学会约翰·桑顿中国中心，2026 年 11 月 10 日。主持人：乔纳森·钦（Jonathan A. Czin，布鲁金斯 Michael H. Armacost 外交政策讲席研究员）、何瑞恩（Ryan Hass，桑顿中国中心主任）；嘉宾：托里吉安（Joseph Torigian，美利坚大学国际服务学院副教授）。 原文与完整文字稿： https://www.brookings.edu/articles/why-is-xi-jinping-purging-leaders-of-his-own-party/ Members of the Communist Party of China Central Committee attend a press conference following the fifth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee in Beijing, China, October 30, 2026. REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov 摘要 一、谣言、恐惧与“不再平反”的清洗 托里吉安开篇就强调要保持“分析上的谦逊”。社交媒体上关于中共高层的传言，大多是因为人们“愿意相信”才流传开来，而且没有人能够证实或证伪。张又侠落马前的传言碰巧属实，但“停了的钟一天也能对两次”。他长期查阅美国档案，发现其中充斥着某位领导人已经去世、某地发生政变之类的假消息。在他看来，历史的作用在于提供时间纵深，帮助我们在证据极少的情况下提出假设，而不是去鉴别某一条传言是否可靠。 他还指出了本轮清洗与毛时代相比的变与不变。1959 年彭德怀被整肃时，毛泽东说“我们不用苏联人那种办法解决问题”，意思是不搞处决。习仲勋被整了 16 年，单独关押期间，他每天来回踱步、数着步数，为的是等到党“回心转意”那一天，身体还能撑得住。如今，处决依然罕见，但平反也不再出现。毛泽东尚且认为蒙冤受难是一种“淬炼”，熬过去的人会更加努力地赢回党的信任；习近平却从来没有对谁说过：“你经历了这么多苦难，我们反而更倚重你。”犯错的代价极其沉重，而且几乎不可能全身而退，这说明体制内的恐惧有多深。托里吉安说：“在美国，你不喜欢自己的政党，可以退出；对这些人来说却没有退路，要么上升，要么彻底出局。”据毛泽东的保健医生记述，当年高层很多人因为压力过大而出现类似的病症，不少人靠安眠药度日。在他看来，这些全会提醒我们，身处这个正与美国竞争的组织之中，究竟是怎样一种处境。 二、犯错即“政治觉悟”问题：清洗背后的意识形态逻辑 托里吉安认为，理解这轮清洗的关键，在于习近平对“党的自我治理”的执着。习近平相信，只有共产党才能把这个国家组织起来、实现“复兴”。他还宣称，党解决了一个连马克思、恩格斯都“没有想到”的问题：一个长期执政的政权，如何保持纯洁，保持理想信念。而谁有“党性”（即相信党的使命，把比个人更大的事业放在生命的中心），由他本人来判定。于是，犯错不再是在复杂环境中的失误，而是“信仰出了问题”，必须清除，以“纯洁队伍”。这种逻辑在党史话语中根深蒂固，习仲勋也说过类似的话：身体再健康，只要沾上一丁点资产阶级个人主义的病菌，也可能一夜之间垮掉。换言之，清洗永远没有可以停下来的那一天。五中全会的文件一方面充满胜利者的口吻，另一方面又强调反腐败斗争“依然严峻复杂”，还用植树护林作比：坏树要不断地拔，林子要不断地管。 地方官员因此左右为难。文件既要求扎紧“制度的笼子”，又批评形式主义、官僚主义；既要求与党中央保持高度一致，又说这与担当作为、因地制宜“并不矛盾”。习近平还认为党内存在大量“两面人”，表面拥护，实际不然。这样一来，甄别干部只能依靠主观的、非法律的间接信号。谁受惩罚、罚得多重、罪名如何定性，取决于党在具体情境下的利益，取决于最高领导人想要达成什么，而通常只有他一个人掌握全部的盘算。托里吉安说，他研究中国政治最核心的困惑是：为什么极其忠诚的人会一再被清洗？问题从来不在于下属对领袖失去信任，而在于领袖对下属失去信任，“权力是自上而下流动的”。他估计，习近平自认为远没有走到毛时代那一步，分寸拿捏得恰到好处；别人或许认为他走得太远，但这本身就是一种主观判断。 三、张升民与张又侠：清洗政治的两张面孔 张升民是这轮清洗的受益者，已升任军委副主席并进入政治局。他曾撰文说，高级军官应当少交朋友，要认识到任何交往都带有政治性质。毛时代一起打天下的老干部彼此往来随意，常常因此惹祸；如今这一代军官，大概不会在饭局上议论习近平。托里吉安引用赵紫阳 1980 年代的一句话：中国政治说到底，就是当面一套，背后一套。获得提拔的人，有的兴奋不已，以为自己会是例外；有的则心怀恐惧，因为位子越高越容易出错，最大的愿望不过是“软着陆”。人们常以为列宁式体制中的人都是权力最大化者，总在伺机扳倒习近平；但实际上，许多人只想平平安安地熬过去。而即便万分小心，也未必能保住自己。 张又侠的经历有其特殊之处。他的父亲在文革中原本像个“不倒翁”，常常站在整人的一边，处境比习仲勋好得多，却在文革末期犯下大错，最终以失势告终。而张又侠在父亲失势的情况下，仍然上了对越作战的前线。这种忠诚，或许正是习近平所看重的。习近平喜欢讲，当年其他太子党不愿去基层时，他去了；不过那时他的父亲正位高权重，而张又侠的父亲已经失势。两人的人生故事，就这样耐人寻味地对应起来。然而到了今年，这位习近平如此倚重的人，也到了“该走的时候”。托里吉安由此想到毛泽东在 1959 年彭德怀被整肃前后说过的一句话：“我的思想、我的理智和我的感情始终是一致的。”常人很难做到这一点，但毛泽东做到了；在他看来，习近平大概也是如此。 四、军队大换血与台海风险 主持人钦（Jonathan A. Czin）指出，张又侠只是众多案例中的一个，解放军出身的中央委员大多已被免职。他把自己的观察方法比作印象派绘画：盯着一个点看，只会看得眼花；退后一步，才能看清整体图案。对军队领导层进行如此彻底的代际清洗，会带来什么影响？托里吉安坦言只能推测。在清洗的阴影下，解放军高层恐怕很难把多少心思放在台海作战上，很难说清洗对战备没有影响。但在习近平看来，解放军过去之所以成功，恰恰在于它有正确的“政治觉悟”，因此必须以极大的力度反腐。对他来说，腐败不只是浪费的问题，更关乎在精英权斗、国内动乱或对美战争中，军队是否听他指挥。一支忠诚的、经过政治教育、有斗志的军队，是绝对必要的条件。即便短期内要付出代价，也必须这么做，“他其实别无选择”。托里吉安还提到一些流传出来的对军队讲话：即使从军事上看打台湾是划算的，也不该打；但如果出于政治原因必须打，即使军事上不划算，也必须打。他对习近平的判断是（他强调这只是推测）：在台湾问题上，习近平最在乎的是能够说自己“把事情往前推进了”，局面比他接手时更好；就目前而言，做到这一点大概就够了。但威权领导人向来会做他们认为能够得逞的事。 五、接班政治：斯大林与毛泽东身后的教训 托里吉安比较了斯大林和毛泽东死后的权力交接。两者的相似之处在于，那都是一场关于谁握有谁的把柄、谁整过谁、谁的旧账最多的较量，处处充满猜忌和恐惧。想要胜出，既要在混战中占据有利位置，又不能动摇党的根基。他从新档案中得出的一个重要结论是：接班斗争通常并不存在“政策最受欢迎的人胜出”这样的遴选机制，也没有一个明确的群体来做决定。结果取决于如何操纵模糊的规则：谁抢先一步，谁能左右在哪里决策、由谁决策。而当规则模糊时，“最终说了算的是手里有枪的人”。这并不是说军队会扮演“造王者”，关键在于谁能使用军队，而不是军队使用谁。 至于习近平是否会终身执政，托里吉安怀疑他自己也还没拿定主意，因为每一个选项都不理想。要避免身后出现混战、国家被带往完全不同的方向，就得在生前选定一个信得过的副手，考察他是否能干、是否听话，并给他时间积累权力和威望。这正是毛泽东在斯大林死后的思路：“不能让赫鲁晓夫那样的人出现”，于是选了刘少奇。刘少奇对毛忠诚，但毛很难相处，他像一位“哲学王”，会一连几个月不露面，而且疑心很重，结果这条路没有走通。毛晚年考虑过多位接班人，最终选定华国锋，而华国锋斗不过邓小平。邓小平“同样挽救了革命，但走的是一条与毛的设想截然不同的路”。如果不选接班人，身后就可能出现他书中所描述的那种局面。影响习近平决定的因素包括：身边副手的政治手腕、其他国家的接班经验（他们一直密切关注俄罗斯）、对美关系是否稳定、经济能否撑住，以及他本人的健康状况。这些外人很难看清，恐怕他本人也不容易看清。托里吉安还补充了一个耐人寻味的观察：习近平认为，西方搞垮共产党国家靠的不是暴力，而是用消费主义和物质主义拉拢体制内的人。在他看来，苏联在戈尔巴乔夫手中解体，并不是制度本身出了问题，而是美国一场成功的渗透行动的结果。这个难题过去从来没有人找到好的答案，习近平身边的人恐怕也清楚，它对中国体制的稳定意味着多大的风险。托里吉安说：“我可不想和这样一个人共处一室：他选人的最高标准是‘和我一样’，同时又有充分的理由怀疑，你只是在他面前装成那样的人。” 节目最后，托里吉安提醒华盛顿，不要高估“派系”分析。共事关系确实非常重要，党内也历来存在相互庇护、相互提携的山头，这正是习近平深恶痛绝的，因为它会侵蚀军队的战斗力，也会让人们对这个体制失去信心。但共事并不等于交情。彭德怀经常对张又侠的父亲大发雷霆，还不止一次撤过他的职；周恩来也曾把他骂哭。但这并不意味着他会因此对谁不忠。习仲勋和王震在 1950 年代初曾因新疆政策发生激烈冲突，后来却成了亦敌亦友的关系。共事经历能帮助我们留意可能发生的事情，但它能告诉我们的，远比想象的要少。他最后说，党史永远只是“最新的一稿”，“我们应当把彼此的分歧当作人民内部矛盾来处理，而不是当作政治觉悟错误的表现”。

title: Weeks after shipment was swiped by China, Pentagon ‘struggles to account for’ $31 billion in missing F-35 aircraft parts
zh_title: 货物被中国盗走几周后，五角大楼“努力追查”价值 310 亿美元的 F-35 飞机零部件失踪情况
summary: 根据政府问责办公室 (GAO) 本周发布的分析，五角大楼正在努力追踪数量惊人的 2600 万个 F-35 战斗机零件，价值估计达 310 亿美元。美国政府问责局在其报告中批评当前的库存系统“过时、不准确且不完整”。据称，中国盗取了一批经香港转道的 F-35 零件。几周后，政府问责局发布了报告。 GAO 还提供了可能的解决方案；然而，这意味着美国历史上最先进、最昂贵的战斗机可能还没有准备好并且可靠
content:
根据政府问责办公室 (GAO) 本周发布的分析，五角大楼正在努力追踪数量惊人的 2600 万个 F-35 战斗机零件，价值估计达 310 亿美元。美国政府问责局在其报告中批评当前的库存系统“过时、不准确且不完整”。据称，中国盗取了一批经香港转道的 F-35 零件。几周后，政府问责局发布了报告。 GAO 还提供了可能的解决方案；然而，这意味着美国历史上最先进、最昂贵的战斗机可能由于库存管理缺陷而无法准备就绪且可靠。消息人士指出，库存问题一直是 F-35 部署过程中长期存在的一个问题。 F-35 项目在其生命周期内预计耗资 1.9 万亿美元。美国政府问责局表示，这是历史上最昂贵的武器系统。但该监管机构声称，国防部 (DOD) “在 F-35 零部件的问责制和财务报告方面存在长期且持续的缺陷”。需要解决的首要问题是大约 2600 万个不受监控的庞大备件库。这些库存分布在全球 700 个政府和承包商设施中，但管理大量库存的技术已经存在了几十年。早在 9 月份，我们就可能已经看到了 F-35 零件跟踪系统不足的明显症状。
由于沟通和/或责任故障，一名 UPS 工作人员为了节省时间而通过香港运送绝密零件。据称，一名员工被认为错过了一封警告不要转移零件的电子邮件，导致这些零件被中国窃取。 2019 年以来“进展甚微” 令人沮丧的是，这是 GAO 自 2019 年以来的第三份报告，最新发布的报告抱怨国防部在落实过去的建议方面“进展甚微”。例如，《星条旗报》指出，在 2022 年的一份报告中，建议定期对 F-35 零件进行实物盘点，但尚未实施。也没有可靠的程序来验证主承包商的数据，这些数据可能“不准确且不完整”。目前，据信有超过 100 万个零件丢失或失踪，价值超过 8500 万美元。此外，价值高达 425 亿美元的约 17,000 个已送修的零件没有被追踪。 “实时连接”库存系统《星条旗》提到，五角大楼正在为 F-35 联合项目办公室 (JPO) 开发“实时连接”，将其库存软件与主承包商的库存软件与 F-35 零件连接起来。日本特许厅声称，它现在正在通过直接实时接口对其基础设施进行现代化改造。 Breaking Defense 援引 JPO 发言人的话说：“这种集成直接解决了之前的系统缺陷，以确保 F-35 备件的无缝问责。”

【原文 English Original】
The Pentagon is struggling to track an astonishing 26 million F-35 warfighter parts, worth an estimated $31 billion, according to analysis published by the Government Accountability Office (GAO) this week. In its report — published just weeks after China purportedly swiped a classified shipment of F-35 parts diverted through Hong Kong — the GAO criticized the current inventory system as “outdated, inaccurate, and incomplete.” Possible solutions were also provided by the GAO; however, the implications are that the most advanced and costly fighter jets in U.S. history may not be ready and reliable due to inventory management deficiencies. Inventory problems have been a long-standing feature of the deployment of the F-35, notes the source. The F-35 program is estimated to cost $1.9 trillion over its lifecycle. It is the most costly weapon system in history, says the GAO. But the Department of Defense (DOD) has “long-standing and ongoing deficiencies related to the accountability and financial reporting of F-35 parts,” asserts the watchdog. Chief among the issues that need to be addressed is the headlining massive unmonitored pool of roughly 26 million spare parts. These are spread among 700 government and contractor facilities worldwide, but the technology for managing massive inventories has existed for decades. We might have seen a telling symptom of the inadequate F-35 parts tracking system back in September. A communications and/or accountability breakdown resulted in a UPS worker routing top-secret parts through Hong Kong to save time. They were allegedly swiped by China after an employee is thought to have missed an email warning not to divert the parts. “Minimal progress” since 2019 Frustratingly, this is the third report since 2019 from the GAO, and the latest published report complains that the DOD has “made minimal progress” in implementing past recommendations. For example, in a 2022 report, periodic physical inventories of F-35 parts were recommended but have not been implemented yet, notes Stars and Stripes . There is also no reliable procedure for verifying data from prime contractors, which can be “inaccurate and incomplete.” Currently, it is believed that there are over 1 million parts, worth more than $85 million, that are lost or missing. Moreover, about 17,000 parts that have been sent in for repair, worth as much as $42.5 billion, aren’t tracked. “Live connection” inventory system Stars and Stripes mentions that the Pentagon is working on “a live connection” for the F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO), bridging its inventory software and that of prime contractors with F-35 parts. The JPO asserts that it is now modernizing its infrastructure with direct real-time interfaces. “This integration directly addresses previous system gaps to ensure seamless accountability of F-35 spare parts,” said a JPO spokesperson, quoted by Breaking Defense .

Blog War Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Posted Aug 14, 2026 by Martin Armstrong |
The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some 84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.
This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.
The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.
Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.
Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.
A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.
A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA blockade, while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.
This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.
Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.
What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.
This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.
If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge hosts half marathon; justice secretary urges more major events
The Hong Kong section of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge hosted a half marathon on 15 November 2026. Secretary for Justice Eric Lin said he hoped the city would stage more large-scale competitions to showcase its capabilities. Traffic restrictions were in place for the race.
The Hong Kong section of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge hosted a half marathon on the morning of 15 November 2026, with Secretary for Justice Eric Lin, Secretary for Education Edsi Choy, Legislative Council member Kenneth Fok and his wife, former diver Guo Jingjing, among those taking part in the two-kilometre honour cup.
Lin said the weather was comfortable and the atmosphere on site was good. He expressed his delight at having the opportunity to run on the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge and voiced his hope that Hong Kong would organise more large-scale competitions to demonstrate its strength.
The ten-kilometre challenge group started at 6:15 am, with half-marathon challenge and open groups also held.
To facilitate the event, police imposed temporary traffic arrangements on the section of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong link road between the Hong Kong port and the boundary line between Guangdong and Hong Kong. The restrictions remained in place until the race actually finished and the road was reopened to vehicles.
Police said they would adjust traffic arrangements according to traffic and pedestrian flow in the area at the time. They urged members of the public to plan their journeys in advance, exercise patience and follow instructions from officers on site.

5月中旬，一名窃贼闯入八乡一栋三层村屋，撬开二楼阳台门锁进行搜查。没有财产损失。一名家庭佣工发现了这一场景并通知了业主，业主向警方报告了这一事件。
11月中旬，八乡另一栋两层村屋遭窃。入侵者翻过墙，用螺丝刀强行打开客厅的窗户。独居业主听到一楼卧室有响动，便前去查看。他看到窃贼拿着手电筒向客厅里窥视。入侵者爬墙逃跑。
警方认为这两起案件是同一人所为。八乡乡郊巡逻队和元朗警方情报组查阅了大量闭路电视录像，并利用SmartView系统进行情报分析，追踪事发时在该地区发现的一辆可疑车辆。这导致嫌疑人的身份被确认，并于周四被捕。
警方敦促村屋居民在睡觉或离家前锁好所有门窗、大门和阳台门，不要对较高楼层的安全掉以轻心。他们建议在墙壁、入口和阳台周围安装高清闭路电视和运动传感器照明，并向警方报告任何可疑的人或车辆。

Man arrested over Pat Heung village house burglaries after SmartView tracking
Hong Kong police arrested a man for two Pat Heung village house burglaries in May and November. The suspect was identified after officers tracked a suspicious vehicle using the SmartView CCTV scheme. Police urged residents to secure all doors and windows and install security cameras.
15 Nov 2026 at 03:09 HKT · updated 15 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
Hong Kong police have arrested a man in connection with two burglaries at village houses in Pat Heung after tracking a suspicious vehicle through the SmartView CCTV scheme, the force said on Saturday.
In mid-May, a burglar broke into a three-storey village house in Pat Heung, prising open a second-floor balcony door lock and searching the premises. No property was lost. A domestic helper discovered the scene and alerted the owner, who reported the incident to police.
In mid-November, another two-storey village house in Pat Heung was burgled. The intruder climbed over a wall and used a screwdriver to force open a living room window. The owner, who lives alone, heard a noise from the ground-floor bedroom and went to investigate. He saw the burglar holding a flashlight and peering into the living room. The intruder fled by climbing the wall.
Police believe the same person was responsible for both cases. The Pat Heung rural patrol team and the Yuen Long police intelligence unit reviewed large amounts of CCTV footage and used intelligence analysis under the SmartView system to track a suspicious vehicle seen in the area at the time of the incidents. This led to the identification of the suspect, who was arrested on Thursday.
Police urged village house residents to lock all doors, windows, gates and balcony doors before sleeping or leaving home, and not to be complacent about security on higher floors. They advised installing high-definition CCTV and motion-sensor lighting around walls, entrances and balconies, and to report any suspicious people or vehicles to police.

2026年器官捐献日弘扬香港年轻一代的利他主义 |中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 15 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
2026器官捐献日宣扬香港年轻一代的利他精神
2026年香港器官捐赠日于11月14日举行，以鼓励登记并提高认识。卫生部长罗仲茂敦促公民在中央登记册上登记，并指出已有超过 42 万名登记者，但仍有超过 2,000 名患者在等待移植。
2026 年 11 月 14 日 17:30 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 15 日 04:29 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
11月14日举行了2026年香港器官捐献日，政府重点向年轻一代传播无私器官捐献的信息。主持活动的卫生局局长罗仲茂教授表示：“对于等待器官移植的病人来说，器官移植是他们延长生命的希望。”每多一个愿意捐献器官的公民，就为有需要的患者点燃更多的希望，让他们早日摆脱疾病。”他鼓励尚未在中央器官捐献名册上登记的公民进行登记，并将自己的意愿告知家人。
其他主礼嘉宾包括卫生局副局长范文仪医生、卫生署署长林汉基医生、健康推广总监苏培湘医生、广播助理总监叶观林及医院管理局行政总裁李夏欣医生。香港医学专科学院、香港肾脏基金会、香港医学会、香港器官移植基金会、香港肾脏病学会、香港器官移植学会、香港移植运动协会等推动器官捐献的组织代表也出席。
此次活动的特色是肾脏儿童梦想合唱团的表演，他们用歌曲展示器官移植如何改变接受者的生活并向捐赠者致敬。两位年轻的器官接受者分享了移植后的经历，用积极的态度表达了感激之情。 2026器官捐献日大使陈茵媺也用童话故事向学生和家长传达利他主义的信息。
《器官捐献推广约章》自2016年推出以来，已有超过600家企业、团体和学校加入。 2023年，卫生部升级了中央登记系统，允许公民使用“iAM Smart”移动应用程序登记或检查自己的状态。今年，卫生署已在全港18区设立超过2,000个宣传摊位，并举办超过20场健康讲座及培训工作坊。中央登记册的登记人数已超过42万，创历史新高。
然而，香港仍有超过2000名患者仍在等待合适的器官移植。卫生署推出新推广活动，流动器官捐献车于11月12日至明年1月20日期间巡回各地，让市民现场登记。该部门敦促公众记住器官捐献的“3S”：在中央登记册上登记、向家人说出来、向亲友传播信息。

Organ Donation Day 2026 promotes altruism among younger generation in Hong Kong
Hong Kong's Organ Donation Day 2026 was held on 14 November to encourage registration and raise awareness. Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau urged citizens to sign up on the Central Register, noting over 420,000 registrants but more than 2,000 patients waiting for transplants.
14 Nov 2026 at 17:30 HKT · updated 15 Nov, 04:29 · 2 min read
Hong Kong's Organ Donation Day 2026 was held on 14 November, with the government focusing on spreading the message of altruistic organ donation to younger generations. Secretary for Health Professor Lo Chung-mau, who officiated at the event, said: 'For patients waiting for organ transplants, organ transplantation is the hope for them to extend their lives. Every additional citizen willing to donate organs ignites more hope for patients in need, allowing them to be freed from illness sooner.' He encouraged citizens not yet registered on the Central Organ Donation Register to do so, and to inform their families of their wishes.
Other officiating guests included Under Secretary for Health Dr vanessa Fan, Director of Health Dr Ronald Lam, Chief of Health Promotion Dr So Pui-sheung, Assistant Director of Broadcasting Yip Kwun-lam, and Hospital Authority Chief Executive Dr Lee Ha-yan. Representatives from organisations promoting organ donation, including the Hong Kong Academy of Medicine, Hong Kong Kidney Foundation, Hong Kong Medical Association, Hong Kong Organ Transplant Foundation, Hong Kong Society of Nephrology, Hong Kong Transplantation Society, and Hong Kong Transplant Sports Association, also attended.
The event featured a performance by the Kidney Children Dream Choir, which used song to show how organ transplants change recipients' lives and to honour donors. Two young organ recipients shared their post-transplant experiences, expressing gratitude through their positive attitudes. Organ Donation Day 2026 ambassador Aimee Chan also used a fairy tale to spread the message of altruism to students and parents.
Since the launch of the Organ Donation Promotion Charter in 2016, more than 600 businesses, organisations and schools have joined. In 2023, the Department of Health upgraded the Central Register system to allow citizens to register or check their status using the 'iAM Smart' mobile app. This year, the department has set up more than 2,000 promotional booths across Hong Kong's 18 districts and held over 20 health talks and training workshops. The number of registrants on the Central Register has exceeded 420,000, a record high.
However, more than 2,000 patients in Hong Kong are still waiting for suitable organ transplants. The Department of Health has launched a new promotional campaign, with a mobile organ donation van touring various locations from 12 November to 20 January next year, allowing citizens to register on-site. The department urged the public to remember the '3S' of organ donation: Sign up on the Central Register, Speak out to family, and Spread out the message to relatives and friends.

香港部长在奖学金颁奖典礼上敦促年轻科技人才追求创新 |中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 15 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港部长在奖学金颁奖典礼上敦促年轻科技人才追求创新
香港创新负责人赞扬了青年科技奖学金计划的 30 名学生获奖者，赞扬政府为扩大 STEM 实习机会和培养年轻人才以实现香港创新中心的雄心所做的努力。
2026 年 11 月 14 日 17:00 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 15 日 04:24 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港创新及科技局局长于 11 月 14 日在 2026 年中银国际“科技精英，赋能香港”青年人才奖学金颁奖典礼上致辞，祝贺 30 名学生获奖者，并概述了政府推动 STEM 教育和实习的计划。
秘书强调，香港教育工作者联会50多年来一直致力于推动STEM教育，是培养年轻科技人才的重要合作伙伴。他表示，政府正在加快建设国际科技创新中心，年轻人是重要力量。
政府推行教育、技术和人才发展的综合方法，包括扩大“创新与技术实习计划”，以支持 STEM 学生获得早期行业接触机会。秘书指出，创新园区还提供实习、培训和创业机会。
他列举了获得国际奖项并参与国家太空任务的香港科学家作为年轻科技爱好者的榜样。他表示，政府将为青年实现创新梦想搭建更好的平台。
书记引用古文《荀子》，勉励同学们要在失败中坚持，保持好奇心，用自己的知识为社会做出贡献。他感谢香港教育工作者联会和中银国际组织是次活动。

Hong Kong minister urges young tech talents to pursue innovation at scholarship ceremony
Hong Kong's innovation chief praised 30 student winners of a youth tech scholarship programme, touting government efforts to expand STEM internships and nurture young talent for the city's innovation hub ambitions.
14 Nov 2026 at 17:00 HKT · updated 15 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
Hong Kong's Secretary for Innovation, Science and Technology, speaking at the 2026 BOCI 'Tech Elite, Empowering Hong Kong' youth talent scholarship ceremony on 14 November, congratulated 30 student award winners and outlined government plans to boost STEM education and internships.
The secretary highlighted the Hong Kong Federation of Education Workers, which has promoted STEM education for over 50 years, as a key partner in developing young tech talent. He said the government is accelerating the construction of an international innovation and technology centre, with young people as a vital force.
The government promotes an integrated approach to education, technology and talent development, including expanding the 'Innovation and Technology Internship Scheme' to support STEM students in gaining early industry exposure. Innovation parks also offer internship, training and entrepreneurship opportunities, the secretary noted.
He cited Hong Kong scientists who have won international awards and participated in national space missions as role models for young tech aspirants. The government, he said, will build better platforms for youth to realise their innovation dreams.
Quoting the ancient text 'Xunzi', the secretary urged students to persist through failures and maintain curiosity, using their knowledge to contribute to society. He thanked the Hong Kong Federation of Education Workers and BOCI for organising the programme.

content:
两名男子因涉嫌在新蒲岗一座工业大楼进行非法武器训练而被捕，他们向香港法院表示，他们打算承认共谋颠覆罪。湾仔区域法院。资料图片：HKFP。据当地媒体报道，学生邓毅博和服务员陈晓俊周四在区域法院出庭。辩方告诉陈士丹法官，两人计划认罪。两人是去年 12 月被指控串谋颠覆罪的五名被告之一。五人现已在法庭上表示他们打算认罪。法官表示，五人定于明年 3 月 15 日一起提出抗辩。在此之前，他们将继续被还押。据当地媒体报道，十月份，另外三名被告——学生黄杰伦、保安彭嘉良和保安李俊森——告诉法庭，他们将承认颠覆罪指控。黄还被指控持有儿童色情制品。检方10月在法庭上表示，已与辩方达成认罪协议：在黄承认颠覆罪后，持有儿童色情制品的指控将被存档。去年 12 月，唐和陈被指控时均为 23 岁。李当时26岁，彭24岁，黄21岁。2024年10月1日，人们在香港历史博物馆观看有关国家安全的视频装置。
图片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。检方指称，2024年11月1日至2025年12月11日期间，五名被告伙同及伙同其他不明人士，组织、策划、实施或参与以武力或以武力相威胁的行为，以颠覆国家政权、推翻香港特别行政区权力机构。根据第二十三条逮捕 这五人是去年12月11日和12月12日被捕的10人之一。警司周学贤表示，警方于 12 月 11 日持法院搜查令突击搜查新蒲岗工业大厦的一个单位，发现里面有 6 名男子，其中一名正在为其他人进行战斗训练。周说，警方缴获了五支气步枪、两支气手枪、五把军刀和一把长剑的仿制品，以及带有反政府标语的物品。他用粤语说：“此外，我们还发现了疑似爆炸物。”他补充说，警方爆炸品处理科正在检查这些物品。警方其后在大埔及油麻地拘捕另外三名男子。 12月12日，他们逮捕了一名妇女。所有这些人都是根据《维护国家安全条例》中的“非法钻探”条款被捕的，该条例是该市当地制定的安全立法，称为第 23 条。其中五人后来被指控串谋颠覆国家政权。

【原文 English Original】
Two men have told a Hong Kong court that they intend to plead guilty to conspiracy to commit subversion after they were arrested on suspicion of illegal weapons training in an industrial building in San Po Kong. District Court in Wan Chai. File photo: HKFP. Student Tang Ngai-pok and waiter Chan Hiu-chun appeared at the District Court on Thursday, local media reported . The defence told Judge Stanley Chan that the duo planned to plead guilty to the charges. The two are among five defendants who were charged with conspiracy to commit subversion last December. All five have now stated in court that they intend to plead guilty. The judge said the five were set to enter their pleas together on March 15 next year. They will remain remanded in custody until then. In October, the other three defendants – student Wong Kit-lun, security guard Gallian Pang and security guard Lee Chun-sum – told the court that they would plead guilty to the subversion charges, local media reported . Wong was also charged with possession of child pornography. The prosecution said in court in October that a plea bargain had been reached with the defence: after Wong pleaded guilty to subversion, the charge of possession of child pornography would be left on file. Tang and Chan were both 23 years old when they were charged last December. Lee was 26 at the time, while Pang was 24 and Wong was 21. People watch a video installation on national security in the Hong Kong Museum of History, on October 1, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The prosecution alleged that between November 1, 2024 and December 11, 2025, the five defendants conspired together and with other persons unknown to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by force or threat of force with a view to subverting state power and overthrowing the body of power of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Arrests under Article 23 The five were among a group of 10 people who were arrested on December 11 and December 12 last year. Superintendent Chow Hok-yin said that officers raided a unit at the San Po Kong industrial building on December 11 with a court warrant and found six men inside, one providing combat training to the others. Officers seized five air rifles, two air pistols, replicas of five military knives and a long sword, as well as items bearing anti-government slogans, Chow said. “Additionally, we found objects suspected to be explosives,” he said in Cantonese, adding that the objects were being examined by the force’s Explosive Ordnance Disposal Bureau. Police later arrested another three men in Tai Po and Yau Ma Tei. On December 12, they arrested a woman. All of them were arrested under the “unlawful drilling” provision of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, the city’s locally enacted security legislation known as Article 23. Five were later charged with conspiracy to commit subversion.
